Contract ManageSupplierCRUDService::deleteSupplier(id: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		supplier: Supplier = Supplier.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = id)
	precondition:
		supplier.oclIsUndefined() = bool
	postcondition:
		let newSupplier: Supplier in
		newSupplier.oclIsNew() and
		Supplier.allInstance()->includes(newSupplier) and
		result = true
}
